messages:
maggie.marketing: Morning — new draft (v1.2) of the launch post is live: https://docs.google.com/example/launch-v1.2 Need: quick copy pass, legal signoff, and final CTA/UTM values for the demo funnel by EOD so we can queue publish + webinar invites.

sam.copy: will take a pass in the next hour. Quick thought: swap the technical paragraph with the customer story earlier to improve flow. Also can we tighten the hero to one sentence?

maggie.marketing: agreed on hero tightening. Sam, keep one-line hero + 2-sentence kicker. Devon, want the CTAs to map to our three conversion buckets again?

devon.growth: yes — CTA buckets: hosted trial, dedicated trial, enterprise pilot. Proposed utm_content: `hosted_trial`, `dedicated_trial`, `enterprise_pilot`. Also propose two lead tags: `blog_announce_mql` for generic interest, `blog_announce_enterprise` for pilot signups.

nate.ops: fine with those. CRM routing snippet I'll use: 
```
utm_campaign=redwood_launch_may2026
utm_medium=blog_cta
utm_source=blog
utm_content=hosted_trial|dedicated_trial|enterprise_pilot
```
I'll set auto-assign rules after publish.

elaine.legal: reviewed claims. Two small asks: 1) remove the 'lowest in-market latency' phrasing (too absolute); 2) add a line in Data Controls referencing customer-managed keys + retention options. Otherwise ok.

sam.copy: removing the absolute claim and adding: "optional customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) and configurable retention policies." Any objections?

devon.growth: no objections. One more: include a one-line takeaway for the benchmark chart and link to a separate appendix PDF for the full data — keeps page speedy.

maggie.marketing: good call — link to appendix and note: "See benchmark appendix for full methodology." Sam, also add one-line takeaway like "Redwood matches top-tier latency while reducing per-token cost by ~X% on typical RLHF workloads" (we'll fill X with the final number after QA).

sam.copy: placeholder `~X%` added with TODO tag.

alex.events: webinar date proposal: Tue May 12, 2026 at 16:00 UTC. Recommend reserving 12 demo slots for post-webinar sessions and a waitlist form. Also need the short invite blurb for the calendar — 2 lines max.

maggie.marketing: ok lock 12 slots. Alex, draft calendar blurb and demo signup form link and drop here.

alex.events: calendar blurb: "Product launch + live demo: See how Redwood delivers predictable, production-grade LLM inference. 30-min demo + 15-min Q&A." Demo form link: https://forms.example/signup-demo.

devon.growth: Sales ask: flag anyone that clicks `enterprise_pilot` and visited pricing page as PQL. Nate will you add that rule?

nate.ops: yes — will add a pixel to the pricing page and create a workflow: `visit_pricing && utm_content=enterprise_pilot => tag: blog_announce_enterprise + assign to AE queue`.

elaine.legal: last check: add a one-line excerpt under "Security & Compliance" that we support SOC2 and customer-managed KMS. Approving once present.

sam.copy: added the security line. Removing marketing-y superlatives.

maggie.marketing: timeline: finish copy edits by 16:30 UTC, legal final by 17:00 UTC, Devon to confirm UTMs and tracking by 17:15, Alex to finalize invites. If all green, embargo lift tomorrow 09:00 UTC.

publish-bot: Reminder: embargo scheduled for 2026-05-10 09:00 UTC. React with :white_check_mark: when you approve final copy.

maggie.marketing: will post final doc link here after Sam finishes. Thanks everyone.
